text:
mike: Quick FYI: launching two billing changes 2026-06-15 — (1) graded rate-limits for free/trial tiers (soft -> hard stages) and (2) optional auto-topup for accounts with a saved card. Goal: reduce surprise throttles and give customers a self-serve path to avoid interruptions.

tara: Please share exact staging rules. Product needs to update error copy in the Console.

mike: Staging rules (summary): free/trial accounts hit soft threshold at 75% of monthly tokens -> 429s become advisory (x-quota-warning header + notification). At 95% -> enforced soft-throttle (reduced concurrency), and at 110% -> hard throttle after 24h unless auto-topup used. Paid accounts: soft buffer 10%, then burst degrades linearly.

ollie: Auto-topup behavior? We need charges and dispute flow defined for billing.

mike: Auto-topup is opt-in in Console. If enabled, when an account crosses 100% usage we attempt a single topup charge (default $50 USD, configurable). If payment succeeds, tokens are credited and service continues. If it fails, we send invoice + 48h notice then apply hard throttle.

legal: Need copy for consent and TOS change. Also require a separate opt-in checkbox (no bundled consent). I'll draft a short clause.

billing-bot: Note: invoice batch for post-enforcement overages scheduled for 2026-06-16T04:00Z.

tara: Engineering notes: add headers `x-quota-warning`, `x-auto-topup-triggered`, and `x-overage-window` (seconds). Also track `auto_topup_attempt` events in billing telemetry. Will open infra task for rate-limit config rollout.

ollie: Support: create a playbook for failed topups, including automatic retry schedule and escalation to Collections after 14 days. Also add a Console banner for users within 10% of soft threshold.

mike: Marketing will write neighborhood-facing FAQ; keep messaging focused on reliability and control (not "we're charging more"). We'll send a targeted email to accounts that have had >2 months of sustained free-tier overage.

tara: Any SLA changes for Dedicated customers?

mike: No SLA changes. Dedicated and Enterprise unaffected by these free/trial gradations — only applies to free/trial and standard pay-as-you-go tiers.

legal: Also require data retention note for topup receipts and disputed payments.

mike: Schedule: 2026-05-20 internal review -> 2026-06-01 docs freeze -> 2026-06-15 enforcement.

billing-bot: Reminder: create migration to backfill `auto_topup_opt_in` flag for accounts with saved payment methods by 2026-06-05.

mike: Thanks all — tagging owners: @tara (engineering), @ollie (support), @legal (policy), @marketing for comms. We'll post the public Help Center article on 2026-06-01.
